    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_assign_automatically_stops_at_quota(self):
        self.quota.items.add(self.item1)
        self.quota.size = 2
        self.quota.save()
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            for i in range(5):
                WaitingListEntry.objects.create(
                    event=self.event, item=self.item1, email='foo{}@bar.com'.format(i)
                )
        assert assign_automatically(self.event.pk) == 2
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            assert Voucher.objects.count() == 2
            assert WaitingListEntry.objects.filter(voucher__isnull=True).count() == 3

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_assign_automatically_respects_priority(self):
        self.quota.items.add(self.item1)
        self.quota.size = 1
        self.quota.save()
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            WaitingListEntry.objects.create(
                event=self.event, item=self.item1, email='first@bar.com'
            )
            vip = WaitingListEntry.objects.create(
                event=self.event, item=self.item1, email='vip@bar.com', priority=10
            )
        assert assign_automatically(self.event.pk) == 1
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            vip.refresh_from_db()
            assert vip.voucher is not None
            assert WaitingListEntry.objects.filter(voucher__isnull=True).get().email == 'first@bar.com'

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_assign_automatically_records_user(self):
        self.quota.items.add(self.item1)
        self.quota.size = 1
        self.quota.save()
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            user = User.objects.create_user('admin@example.org', 'dummy')
            WaitingListEntry.objects.create(
                event=self.event, item=self.item1, email='foo@bar.com'
            )
        assert assign_automatically(self.event.pk, user.pk) == 1
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            assert LogEntry.objects.filter(
                action_type='pretix.voucher.added', user=user
            ).count() == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_assign_automatically_subevent(self):
        self.event.has_subevents = True
        self.event.save()
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            se1 = self.event.subevents.create(name='Date 1', date_from=now())
            se2 = self.event.subevents.create(name='Date 2', date_from=now())
            for se in (se1, se2):
                q = Quota.objects.create(name='Q', size=5, event=self.event, subevent=se)
                q.items.add(self.item1)
                for i in range(2):
                    WaitingListEntry.objects.create(
                        event=self.event, item=self.item1, subevent=se,
                        email='foo{}@{}.bar.com'.format(i, se.pk)
                    )
        assert assign_automatically(self.event.pk, subevent_id=se1.pk) == 2
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            assert Voucher.objects.filter(subevent=se1).count() == 2
            assert Voucher.objects.filter(subevent=se2).count() == 0
        assert assign_automatically(self.event.pk) == 2
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            assert Voucher.objects.filter(subevent=se2).count() == 2
EOF
